name: folio-site-assets
description: Not built with npm: assets/fuse-worker.mjs and assets/fuse.worker.mjs are copies of Fuse.js. This file and package-lock.json name that version so that the vulnerability scan (.github/workflows/vulncheck.yml) sees it. Change the version here, run `npm install --package-lock-only`, and replace the files in assets/ together; fuse_test.go checks that they match.
